reasoning: Independent source-only inspection of panel.png established the main frame at approximately X=118–651 px and Y=68–498 px, linear Relative Pressure (P/P₀) and Uptake (cm³ g⁻¹) axes, blue open-circle solid CO2@195K ink, and excluded red N2@77K ink. The inset mask X=190–523,Y=168–403 px was treated as excluded context; no inset coordinates were emitted. Native major-tick strokes were fitted independently before candidate review. After loading the complete Agent 03 table, every row was checked against panel.png. The fused low-pressure strip was not treated as a set of automatically detected marker centres: unsupported direct-marker claims were deleted, while 12 low-confidence line_sample rows retain the visible CO2 centreline through the continuous band and connecting rise. From the saved CSV there are 46 direct visible/partial markers, one estimated origin marker, and 12 trace samples. Five omitted native markers were added at (150,292), (237,119), (310,116), (587,111), and (611,108) px. Marker centres in separable regions were recentered from native rim/core symmetry. The wholly fused origin is explicitly estimated at the zero-axis intersection from blue CO2 ink, its own trajectory, and the shared N2 origin column, so the verdict is review. The complete review_tiles.json inventory was examined. slot:0001 and slot:0002 have null source pixels and a listed bbox [0,68,33,497] outside the plot frame; those slot records provide no native support for additions, so decisions there were based on the actual panel strip instead. Reloaded-CSV reconstruction and overlay were inspected: points track the source curve, exclude the inset/N2 series, and continuous fused spans are sampled at no more than about 14 px in the vertical strip; plateau centre spacings are about 24–25 px between approximately 18–20 px glyphs with visible connecting ink.

Partially fused plateau/rising markers retain low confidence where only arc symmetry survives.
